name: child_dress_item
description: a small white child's dress, size for a three-year-old. the hem is stained with something dark that has long since dried to brown. no dress this small belongs in the master bedroom.

params.success_message: as you lift the dress, a lullaby plays faintly from somewhere in the room. it stops when you set the dress down. the dress is cold and damp, as if recently washed but not dried.
